title: The Gantry Limiter's Override
logline: A shipyard accident investigator examining a deadly orbital crane collapse discovers that the crane did not snap from wear, but was ripped from its moorings by a debtor freighter firing its engines to escape an illegal port repossession.

roles.description: An uncompromising shipyard accident investigator; methodical, stubborn, and pressured by union bosses to find the truth.
Master of a heavily modified bulk freighter; desperate, hounded by creditors, and on the run after a botched escape.
Chief repossession officer for the station port authority; ruthless, overzealous, and cutting legal corners to seize ships.
An armored port authority cutter fitted with magnetic boarding clamps and disruptor cannons.
A tangled debris drift of twisted gantry girders and sheared hydraulic rams floating beside the dock.
The massive pressurized orbital ring where capital freighters and warships are overhauled.
The militant labor syndicate of orbital riggers, welders, and heavy equipment mechanics.

public_situation: Shipyard riggers strike across {system} after an orbital crane sheared from its moorings, crushing four drydock berths and killing six workers.
private_truth: The crane did not suffer mechanical failure; a berthed debtor ship engaged full thrusters while still hooked to the gantry grapple to escape an illegal predawn repossession.

beats.public_change: Work halts across {role:dockyard_gantry_ring} as the shipwright guild demands an independent accident inquest.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to scan the sheared winch grapple in the debris field to verify whether the structural break was metallurgical fatigue or sudden thrust shear.
missions.private_fact: She spotted plasma wash on the sheared grapple clamps suggesting main engine ignition before the break.

beats.public_change: {role:port_bailiff} orders a news blackout and dispatches armed security tugs to impound all drydock sensor logs.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to intercept a rogue bailiff scrapper tug and recover the gantry's external telemetry array before it is wiped.
missions.private_fact: The bailiff launched an uncertified impound raid without clearance, prompting the debtor captain's panic burn.

beats.public_change: The fugitive debtor freighter is spotted limping into an outer asteroid belt with burned-out thrusters.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to deliver the extracted thruster telemetry to the union hall under the bailiff's security cordon.
missions.private_fact: If the union learns the bailiff provoked the disaster, they will shut down the entire orbital transit network.

beats.public_change: {role:bailiff_interceptor} corners the crippled debtor freighter in deep space, powering weapons to destroy the witness ship.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to disable the bailiff cutter before it silences the debtor captain and destroys the surviving ship logs.
missions.private_fact: The bailiff hails mid-fight offering a massive official bounty and debt clearance if the pilot lets the cutter incinerate the debtor ship.

player_choice.prompt: With the bailiff cutter neutralized and the debtor captain in custody, the pilot must decide who takes the blame for the crane disaster.

options.label: Deliver the flight telemetry to the shipwright guild to expose the bailiff's reckless impound raid
Help the debtor captain jump to safety while letting management settle the strike quietly
Surrender the debtor captain to the port authority to claim the official fugitive bounty

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the telemetry to the shipwright guild.
resolutions.summary: The union proves {role:port_bailiff} provoked the crane disaster with an illegal impound raid. The bailiff is imprisoned, and the port authority pays massive restitution to the riggers' families.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an overzealous port bailiff provoked a fatal crane collapse during an illegal ship repossession.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the debtor captain jump to safety.
resolutions.summary: {role:debtor_captain} jumps clear of the system. The port authority pays off the union under a non-disclosure pact, while {role:salvage_inspector} resigns in frustration.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a desperate freighter captain escape after an accidental crane disaster.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the debtor captain to the bailiff.
resolutions.summary: {role:debtor_captain} takes the sole blame for six rigger deaths and receives lifetime hard labor. {role:port_bailiff} is promoted, while the union remains bitter and suspicious.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot captured a fugitive freighter captain who pulled down an orbital shipyard crane during a botched escape.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the inquest or accepts the bailiff's bribe.
resolutions.summary: {role:port_bailiff} destroys the telemetry and blames the disaster on dead riggers. The shipwright guild launches an indefinite general strike, shutting down the orbital ring.

loose_threads.detail: The repossession docket for the debtor ship was signed without magistrate authorization by a commercial debt registry clerk.
The sheared grapple teeth carry titanium-hydride thruster slag matching an uncertified civilian fuel blend.

radio_hooks: Orbital crane disaster halts repair operations at central drydock gantry.
Shipwright guild threatens wildcat walkouts over deadly drydock equipment failures.
Station port marshal launches emergency investigation into sheared gantry winches.

voice_direction.salvage_inspector: Clipped, precise, and rigorously cites mechanical shear tolerances. Refuses to make eye contact when angry.
voice_direction.debtor_captain: Frantic, exhausted, and speaks in broken, stammering sentences. Clearly horrified by the rigger deaths but terrified of prison.
voice_direction.port_bailiff: Loud, domineering, and treats the star system as his personal enforcement jurisdiction. Threats are delivered with a jovial smirk.
